implemented: Cash dividends carry source identity, digest, ex-date, payment date, application date, eligible shares, gross income and withholding.

Cash yield accrues over an effective interval from reconstructed daily closing cash and a sourced annual rate; undated cash events, overlapping periods, negative balances and retroactive NAV rewrites are rejected.
Return reconciliation bridges NAV change net of external flows to realized and marked unrealized price P&L, gross dividend and cash-yield income, fees and tax.
